mentions.name: US Energy Cost Explorer
mentions.description: A free map-based tool for exploring electricity and natural gas costs across the US. Users can compare states, follow prices over time, and examine bills and energy burden, making energy affordability data easier to access and understand.
mentions.problem: Energy cost and affordability information is difficult for people to access and understand.
mentions.source_excerpt: US Energy Cost Explorer (https://energy-maps.com) is a free tool for exploring electricity and natural gas costs across the US. You can compare states, follow prices over time, and look at bills and energy burden.
mentions.author: ebaumer
